title: Basic Project Proposal
description: A simple proposal template to outline scope and pricing.
intro: Use this proposal to summarize scope, deliverables, timeline, and cost.
whenToUse: When pitching services or projects to clients.
template:
Proposal Title: [Project]
Client: [Name]
Scope: [Deliverables]
Timeline: [Dates]
Cost: [Amount]
example:
Proposal Title: Branding Refresh
Client: Greenleaf Co.
Scope: Logo, color palette, basic guidelines
Timeline: 4 weeks
Cost: $4,500

faqs.question: Should I include payment milestones?
faqs.answer: Yes — they help manage expectations and cash flow.

title: Meeting Agenda Template
description: A simple meeting agenda to keep discussions focused.
intro: Use this agenda to structure team or client meetings.
whenToUse: Before scheduled meetings to share topics and time allocations.
example:
Meeting: Project Kickoff
Date: May 18, 2026
Attendees: PM, Designer, Dev
Agenda:
- Scope review
- Timeline
- Next steps

faqs.question: How long should agendas be?
faqs.answer: Keep items focused and assign time estimates for each.

title: Simple Consulting Agreement
description: A concise consulting agreement for short-term engagements.
intro: Use this agreement to define scope, payment, and deliverables for consultants.
whenToUse: When hiring or engaging an external consultant.
template:
Agreement between [Client] and [Consultant].
Scope: [Services]
Fee: [Amount]
Term: [Dates]
example:
Agreement between Bright Agency and Mira Chen.
Scope: UX audit
Fee: $1,200
Term: May 2026

faqs.question: Should consultants have NDAs?
faqs.answer: Often yes — include confidentiality provisions if needed.

title: Marketing Campaign Proposal
description: Proposal template focused on marketing campaign scope and results.
intro: Outline goals, channels, timeline, and budget for campaigns.
whenToUse: When pitching a marketing campaign to clients or internal stakeholders.
example:
Project: Summer Promo
Objective: Increase leads by 25%
Channels: Email, Social
Budget: $8,000
Timeline: June–August 2026

title: Meeting Minutes Template
description: A template to record meeting notes and action items.
intro: Capture decisions, owners, and next steps from meetings.
whenToUse: After meetings to distribute notes and actions.
template:
Meeting: [Title]
Date: [Date]
Attendees: [Names]
Notes:
- [Point]
Action Items:
- [Task] assigned to [Name]
example:
Meeting: Weekly Sync
Date: May 18, 2026
Attendees: Team
Action Items: Update roadmap (Owner: Priya)

title: Consulting Scope of Work
description: A scope of work template clarifying consulting deliverables.
intro: Define tasks, deliverables, timeline, and fees for consultants.
whenToUse: When engaging a consultant and wanting clear deliverables.
example:
Scope: UX review
Deliverables: Report and prioritized recommendations
Timeline: 2 weeks
Fees: $2,000
